name: Zeonic
description: The civilian company that developed the first mobile suits, and went on to become the Principality of Zeon's main mobile suit supplier. Zeonic is responsible for the development of the MS-05 Zaku I and MS-06 Zaku II, as well as later models like the MSM-04 Acguy and MS-14 Gelgoog.

name: Earth Federation Research & Development
description: The Earth Federation Research & Development Division catalogs various mobile weapons developed by national and corporate entities along with developing such technologies often in cooperation with said entities. Machines present under the EFRD umbrella consists of both units developed 'in-house' along with designs that were developed with significant Federation overhead to essentially be considered 'Federation' designs.

name: NeoVenus Construction
description: Originally headquartered in Baikonur, Kazakhstan as a private space agency, the company would become one of the early leaders in space colonization, with Venus in particular being a long-term project. With the advent of the One Year War, NEVEC has also begun its own development line of mobile weapons dubbed "Vital Suits", which are machines designed to handle the rigors of extreme environments and serve as more 'properly' militarized version of the Junior Mobile Suit concept.
